subject.title: [Bug] Dashboard Stop button can corrupt session files + agent permission isolation lacks guardrails

question: Should OpenClaw split #91440 into a Stop/cancel persistence invariant and a host-exec isolation/default-policy invariant, and what default host-exec posture should existing users keep?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the host-exec half changes the documented security boundary and trusted single-operator default; automation should not decide whether existing full/off workflows become denied, approval-required, or sandboxed.

options.title: Split And Preserve Explicit Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open, land Stop drain/recovery proof first, and separately design host-exec isolation or approval defaults with an upgrade-compatible policy.

options.title: Fix Stop Only
options.body: Treat full/off host exec as the documented trusted default, improve docs/doctor guidance, and limit this issue's implementation to the Stop/session corruption path.

options.title: Tighten Host Exec Defaults
options.body: Change the default posture toward sandbox or approval-required destructive/cross-agent access, but require explicit compatibility and migration proof before landing.

recommendation.title: Split And Preserve Explicit Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land Stop drain/recovery proof first, and separately design host-exec isolation or approval defaults with an upgrade-compatible policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal for session-state hardening plus the product/security default decision.
